## ctxloom skill distill

Distill a skill

### Synopsis

Distill a skill to create a token-efficient version.

Reference format: bundle#skills/name

Examples:
  ctxloom skill distill core#skills/code-review
  ctxloom skill distill go-tools#skills/testing --force

```
ctxloom skill distill <bundle>#skills/<name> [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -f, --force   Re-distill even if unchanged
  -h, --help    help for distill
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --degraded        degrade instead of failing: downgrade fatal startup findings (broken config, unresolvable profiles/bundles, failed hook applies) to warnings and launch anyway
      --format string   Output format: text or json (default "text")
      --no-companions   skip companion loadout discovery: do not execute companion binaries (ltk, taskloom, ...) or contribute their skills, hooks, MCP servers and context
```
